description.en: Personal WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness: pair one or more WeChat accounts by scanning a QR code in the Plugins panel, then talk to your agent from WeChat with one DSH conversation per contact or group. Text, images, video, documents and archives travel both ways; inbound media is decrypted to $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox and handed to the model as a path, and the agent sends files back through its wechat_send_file tool. Sensitive operations can be approved from WeChat itself (reply 1 to allow once, 2 to reject; unanswered requests fall back to the GUI after a timeout), and a card panel lists every contact and group with Allow / Ignore / Clear plus an optional allowlist mode. Accounts, receive cursors, session routes and allowlist decisions persist under $DSH_HOME, so restarting dsh keeps the login and one click re-pairs. No OpenClaw install, no external service and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的个人微信桥：在插件面板扫码配对（支持多个微信号同时在线），之后在微信里和 agent 对话，每个联系人/群各自一个独立 DSH 会话。文字、图片、视频、文档、压缩包双向互通；收到的媒体解密落盘到 $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox 并以路径交给模型，agent 可通过 wechat_send_file 工具把文件发回微信。敏感操作可以在微信里直接审批（回 1 批准一次、回 2 拒绝；超时未回复自动转回 GUI），卡片面板列出所有联系人与群，可逐条允许/忽略/清除，并提供可选的「只接收白名单」模式。账号、收消息游标、会话路由与白名单决定都持久化在 $DSH_HOME，重启 dsh 保留登录、一键可重新配对。不需要安装 OpenClaw、不需要外部服务、无运行时依赖。
